messages:
Mira Patel: Kicking off a light canary: q4b-compact on staging against our extractive QA promptset (1k). Seeing repeat truncation in spans, looks like premature EOS tokens.
Sam O'Connor: can you drop a failing id + raw outputs?
Mira Patel: example p_17002: baseline fp16 returns full span, q4b returns 'the primary reason was' then stops. Tokenized outputs show \u2018 and ' being split oddly.
Jorge Alvarez: sounds like a tokenizer token-boundary mismatch after the quant compile. Which tokenizer artifact did the compile embed?
Mira Patel: compile used tokenizer v2 with byte-fallback patch from last week. Build id: build_2026_03_15_q4b.
Keiko Tanaka: label ops flagging: if this is reproducible we should lock a mini-golden (50 anchors) and have labelers adjudicate. label-bot: queue request.
label-bot: queued 50 items to /labeler/mini-golden/q4b-truncation (priority: high). ETA 7h.
Sam O'Connor: I'll run a token-level diff script tonight to compare logits, token-ids, and EOS position between fp16 and q4b.
Sam O'Connor: ```python
# naive diff snippet
from redwood_eval import EvalClient
cli = EvalClient()
out_fp = cli.run(model="fp16-baseline", prompt_id="p_17002", return_tokens=True)
out_q = cli.run(model="q4b-compact", prompt_id="p_17002", return_tokens=True)
print(out_fp['tokens'])
print(out_q['tokens'])
print('eos_idx_fp', out_fp['tokens'].index('<|endoftext|>'))
print('eos_idx_q', out_q['tokens'].index('<|endoftext|>'))
```
Jorge Alvarez: also dump KV cache shapes; some quant kernels reorder attention dims causing shifted positions in longctx.
Keiko Tanaka: on the dedupe front, our embedding-based dedupe (cosine threshold 0.85) now misses pairs under q4b because the embed manifold moved. We should union dedupe sets from both models when building golden.
Mira Patel: noted. I ran a quick NN check: under fp16 p_1045 ~ p_1088 cosine 0.92, under q4b it's 0.68.
Sam O'Connor: plan proposal: 1) gather failing ids (Mira), 2) run fp16 vs q4b token/logit diffs (Sam), 3) recompile q4b with alt kernel flags if diffs point to kv/pos reorder (Jorge), 4) freeze mini-golden unioned via cross-model dedupe (Keiko + label ops), 5) canary rollout 1% then 5% with auto-fallback on >5% regression.
Jorge Alvarez: command for ops to start canary:
```bash
redwoodctl deploy --model q4b-compact --route /extractive-qa --traffic 1% --fallback fp16-baseline --watch-errors 1%
```
OpsBot: deploy command accepted for q4b-compact to /extractive-qa at 1% traffic; alerting on error-rate >1%.
Keiko Tanaka: labelers assigned, focusing first on 7 high-priority anchors Mira flagged. We'll use tag schema: failure_type, suspected_cause, adjudicated_answer, notes.
Mira Patel: I've started a tiny repro repo with sample diffs and token dumps, attaching run artifacts to issue.
Sam O'Connor: I'll add --dedupe-mode union-fp16-q4b to the eval harness so golden freeze doesn't drop near-duplicates due to embed drift.
Jorge Alvarez: if alternate kernel compile fixes it, we should re-run embed generation since embeddings shift after kernel changes.
Keiko Tanaka: label-bot: can you bump ETA to 5h for the 7 anchors? Upshift capacity.
label-bot: bumped priority queue "/labeler/priority/q4b-truncation" (ETA now 5h).
Mira Patel: thanks. Once label adjudication is done, we'll update the golden set and re-run the full eval: regression checks (F1/span-accuracy), latency, token-accuracy. If stable, step to 5% then 20%.
Sam O'Connor: I'll push diffs and a small dashboard to the issue.
Mira Patel: creating issue now and linking artifacts: https://git.redwood.com/r/redwood-inference/ops/issues/2419
Keiko Tanaka: will post label adjudications here when done. :thumbsup:
Mira Patel: appreciate it. Let's reconvene after label pass and diff attachments.
